qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of the CPU graph on a CPU task page?
qa_pairs.answer: The CPU graph on a CPU task page allows users to visualize the requested CPU cores over time.

qa_pairs.question: How can users interact with the CPU graph to customize the displayed information?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can select or deselect different CPU cores on the right side of the CPU graph to customize the displayed information according to their needs.

qa_pairs.question: Is the CPU graph always available for all CPU tasks?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the CPU graph is not available for very short tasks.
